metadata.description: Spec-first agentic development, also called specification-driven agentic development: specs reviewed against your code, gated commits, decisions on record.

plugins.name: spec-first
plugins.description: 9 skills and a commit gate for spec-first agentic development (specification-driven): bootstrap projects, create specs in their own worktree, review specs against the code, apply them, deliver them as a pull request or a whole series as one, log decisions, sync methodology updates. The gate runs the verify stages at every spec commit.
